title: An unanswered gate its session just added can be reworded or removed with a backlog.py command
goal: From the SP-matmvkn6 close retrospective: the ST-tudbg2a6 research worker's gate question named gitlab, which classed it as a push gate only the operator answers; with no command to edit or remove a gate it reverted the item file and added the gate again. backlog.py gate remove ID GATE removes an unanswered gate, refusing an answered one and the sprint's start gate; a gate of class secrets, push or agents-rule is removed only with --by operator and otherwise refused naming the class (gate g2), so a worker cannot clear a gate only the operator answers; a reword is remove then gate add (gate g1), and kb/_self/backlog.md's rule that a gate is never reworded to change its class says what that allows.

run: import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile; t=tempfile.mkdtemp(); os.makedirs(t+"/_backlog"); open(t+"/_backlog/ST-testtest.json","w").write(json.dumps({"id":"ST-testtest","kind":"story","title":"t","status":"draft","goal":"g","touches":["x.md"]})); r=lambda *a: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","--root",t,*a],capture_output=True,text=True); add=lambda g,q: r("gate","add","ST-testtest","--id",g,"--kind","provisional","--question",q,"--option","alpha","--option","beta","--recommendation","alpha"); gates=lambda: json.loads(open(t+"/_backlog/ST-testtest.json").read()).get("gates",[]); add("g8","one?"); add("g9","two?"); r("answer","ST-testtest","g9","--answer","alpha","--by","agent"); open(t+"/_backlog/SP-testtest.json","w").write(json.dumps({"id":"SP-testtest","kind":"sprint","title":"t","status":"planned","goal":"g","gates":[{"id":"start","kind":"blocking","question":"q?","options":["approve","change"],"recommendation":"approve"}]})); x=r("gate","remove","ST-testtest","g8"); y=r("gate","remove","ST-testtest","g9"); z=r("gate","remove","SP-testtest","start"); add("g7","Should the kb be pushed to origin?"); u=r("gate","remove","ST-testtest","g7"); kept=[g["id"] for g in gates()]; v=r("gate","remove","ST-testtest","g7","--by","operator"); sys.exit(0 if x.returncode==0 and y.returncode!=0 and z.returncode!=0 and u.returncode!=0 and "g7" in kept and v.returncode==0 and [g["id"] for g in gates()]==["g9"] and "start" in open(t+"/_backlog/SP-testtest.json").read() else 1)

gates.question: Which commands change an unanswered gate?
options: gate remove ID GATE only; a reword is remove then gate add, which classes the new text again
gate remove and gate reword ID GATE with --question and --option, which classes it again
gates.recommendation: gate remove ID GATE only; a reword is remove then gate add, which classes the new text again
gates.answer: gate remove ID GATE only; a reword is remove then gate add, which classes the new text again

gates.question: Which unanswered gates may gate remove remove, given that kb/_self/backlog.md says a gate is never reworded to change its class?
options: a gate whose class is outside secrets, push and agents-rule; one of those classes only with --by operator, naming the class otherwise
any unanswered gate, and the removal is recorded in the item's notes
gates.recommendation: a gate whose class is outside secrets, push and agents-rule; one of those classes only with --by operator, naming the class otherwise
gates.answer: a gate whose class is outside secrets, push and agents-rule; one of those classes only with --by operator, naming the class otherwise

notes: SP-2vhfsn4o evidence: three workers added a gate the classifier made blocking with no command to remove it; one hand-edited the item JSON to drop it (BG-ovvvqtxf), one stopped with a stray g2 its repro added (BG-jj2nc5ou). Planned at the 2026-10-10 whole-backlog triage, which the operator asked to end with every draft planned into a sprint or dropped (sprint 8 of 13, "Gates: commands, classing and host checks"); the triage reviewer found it serves the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test F2: a content sprint from the research queue lands on headless Sonnet workers. Premise run 2026-10-10 (plan SP-qxcj7fgy): backlog.py gate offers only add; gate remove exits 2 'invalid choice': reproduces.

run: import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile; t=tempfile.mkdtemp(); os.makedirs(t+"/_backlog"); open(t+"/_backlog/ST-testtest.json","w").write(json.dumps({"id":"ST-testtest","kind":"story","title":"t","status":"draft","goal":"g","touches":["x.md"]})); r=lambda *a: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","--root",t,*a],capture_output=True,text=True); add=lambda g,q: r("gate","add","ST-testtest","--id",g,"--kind","provisional","--question",q,"--option","alpha","--option","beta","--recommendation","alpha"); gates=lambda: json.loads(open(t+"/_backlog/ST-testtest.json").read()).get("gates",[]); add("g8","one?"); add("g9","two?"); r("answer","ST-testtest","g9","--answer","alpha","--by","agent"); open(t+"/_backlog/SP-testtest.json","w").write(json.dumps({"id":"SP-testtest","kind":"sprint","title":"t","status":"planned","goal":"g","gates":[{"id":"start","kind":"blocking","question":"q?","options":["approve","change"],"recommendation":"approve"}]})); x=r("gate","remove","ST-testtest","g8"); y=r("gate","remove","ST-testtest","g9"); z=r("gate","remove","SP-testtest","start"); add("g7","Should the kb be pushed to origin?"); u=r("gate","remove","ST-testtest","g7"); kept=[g["id"] for g in gates()]; v=r("gate","remove","ST-testtest","g7","--by","operator"); sys.exit(0 if x.returncode==0 and y.returncode!=0 and z.returncode!=0 and u.returncode!=0 and "g7" in kept and v.returncode==0 and [g["id"] for g in gates()]==["g9"] and "start" in open(t+"/_backlog/SP-testtest.json").read() else 1)
